candidates.description: This feature vector represents German noun and verb prefixes or root morphemes starting with the letters 'ge'.
German verb roots and inflected forms commonly used in informative or instructional texts.
This feature vector activates on common German action verbs in various conjugated and infinitive forms.
These tokens represent German modal verbs and auxiliary verbs expressing necessity, ability, or volition.
This feature vector represents common German adjectives and adverbs used to describe qualities, states, or evaluations.
This feature vector represents German third-person possessive and personal pronouns in various inflected cases.
This feature activates strongly for common German grammatical words, conjunctions, and articles.
These tokens function as German adverbial modifiers indicating degree, emphasis, or temporal aspect.
These tokens represent German transition words, adverbial connectors, and conjunctive particles used to modify the logical flow of sentences.
